sub: 给身体一点滋养
A little nourishment for your body
给忙碌的心一个停顿
Give your busy mind a pause

habits.zh: 对自己说一句温柔的话
sub: 比如：今天这样，也已经很好
Try: what I can do today is enough
只做让身体舒服的动作
Only move in ways that feel comfortable

habits.en: Sit down and enjoy a meal
sub: 让吃饭成为照顾自己的时间
Make a little space to nourish yourself

habits.en: Look at the sky by a window
sub: 给自己一个小小的换气时刻
A small change of scene

habits.en: Put your phone down before bed
sub: 留五分钟，慢慢安静下来
Five minutes to wind down

habits.zh: 允许自己安静休息两分钟
sub: 不用把休息变成另一项任务
You don’t have to earn your rest

habits.en: Say hello to someone you trust
sub: 一句简单的问候就可以
A simple hello is enough

habits.zh: 记下一件今天的小确幸
sub: 再小的事，也可以被记住
Even something tiny is worth keeping

name: 低落
Low
reply: 今天有点难也没关系。不必马上开心，我在这里陪你。
It’s okay if today feels hard. You don’t have to cheer up right away. I’m here.

name: 疲惫
Tired
reply: 辛苦了。可以放下一点事情，休息也是照顾自己。
It’s been a lot. You can set a few things down. Rest is care, too.

name: 平静
Calm
reply: 这样安静的一刻，也值得好好收藏。
A quiet moment like this is worth keeping.

name: 开心
Happy
reply: 真好呀。把一点快乐留给今天的自己吧。
How lovely. Let yourself enjoy this little bright moment.

name: 混乱
Overwhelmed
reply: 不用一次理清全部。我们只做眼前一件小事。
You don’t have to untangle everything. Let’s take one little thing at a time.

name: 圆角黑框眼镜
Soft-square black glasses
desc: 圆润四角，保留一点方框的机灵。
Soft corners, with a hint of a square shape.

name: 无边眼镜
Rimless glasses
desc: 轻轻的镜片，清透的好奇心。
Light lenses for a curious little mind.

name: 银色圆框眼镜
Silver round glasses
desc: 细细的银色圆框，装着温柔的好奇心。
Delicate silver circles for a gentle, curious soul.

name: 浅蓝蝴蝶结
Sky-blue bow
desc: 把今天，打成温柔的结。
A soft little ribbon for today.

name: 莓粉蝴蝶结
Berry-pink bow
desc: 像草莓牛奶一样的小甜蜜。
A little strawberry-milk sweetness.

name: 小鱼实验白大褂
Little-fish lab coat
desc: 带着胸口的小鱼，探索生活。
A little fish, a curious little scientist.

name: 白色针织衫
Plain white knit

A little warmth for an ordinary day.

name: 棕色休闲西装外套
Brown casual blazer

Soft walnut brown for a day at your own pace.

name: 黑色休闲外套

A simple collar and zipper. Settle into being you.

name: 柔软毛毯

desc: 一直都在的安心角落。
Your cozy corner, always here.

name: 鼠尾草小沙发
Sage sofa
desc: 靠一靠，让肩膀休息一下。
Lean back and let your shoulders rest.

name: 游泳圈
Swim ring
desc: 给日常添一点轻盈的想象。
A little floaty daydream for your day.

name: 经典黑色墨镜
Classic black sunglasses

A little cool for a sunny day.

name: 茶色圆框墨镜
Round amber sunglasses
desc: 透过温暖茶色，看看世界。
See the world through warm amber.

name: 草帽
Straw hat
desc: 把阳光轻轻留在帽檐。
A little shade for sunny moments.

name: 黑色头戴式耳机
Black over-ear headphones
desc: 留一首歌的时间给自己。
A song-sized moment just for you.

name: 白色有线耳机
White wired earphones
desc: 把喜欢的声音带在身边。
Keep a comforting sound close.

name: 亮绿色背带裤
Bright green overalls
desc: 清爽的绿色，轻快的小步。
Fresh green for little adventures.

name: 灰衬衫与白短袖

Soft layers for an easy day.

A quiet seat just for you.

name: 安心小屋
Cozy room
desc: 熟悉的小角落，一直都在。
Your familiar little corner.

name: 沙滩
Beach
desc: 听一听，海边轻轻的风。
A gentle moment by the sea.

name: 实验室
Laboratory
desc: 带着好奇心，慢慢探索。
Make room for little discoveries.

name: 大学教室
University classroom

Learning at your own pace.

name: 电影院

A soft glow and a little movie moment.

Corgi
